description:
Discover Palta: Quality craftsmanship, long lasting performance and a ride quality that begs for speed. While others do gravel #WeDoPalta.

The proof that adventure can be competitive, performance doesn’t require a race number, and exploration is better with adrenaline and speed lives in a single name: Palta.

While others tried to define gravel, we marked our own path. Others tried to follow a definition that didn’t exist, we created one coherent with our DNA: #WeDoPalta

Incresed sloping value to allow more seatpost exposure and flex leading to increased comfort.

Taller headtube for less spacers and more comfort. But we didn’t forget about the racers… Riders will have the possibility to mount the stem flush with the head tube for lower stack. #SlamThatStem

The design of the Palta II follows the philosophy of maintaining the overwhelmingly long list of positive elements from the first version and improving, where possibile.

The unique geometry of the advanced fork stays confer both a more precise handling as well as vibration dampening to the ride quality.

Larger spacing between tire and fork allows for better air flow and increased clearance.

Tire clearence up to 45 mm tires with 700c wheels. NOTE: Indicated tire clearence is guaranteed with gravel groupsets. Road bike groupsets follow manufacturer suggested clearence.

Top tube hidden bolts to accomodate compatible bags. 3 different bottle cage positons: 2 on the downtube and 1 on the seat tube.

Palta is compatible with both 2x and 1x electronic and mechanical gropsets, both gravel and road (up to 52-36 chain rings).

A totally hidden fixing solution that is invisible on the frame, intertwining technological and aesthetic innovation. The result is a lightweight, invisible and strong integrated system with three screws, which has been further implemented through the vulcanization of the steel plank. This Basso solution gives the 3B system an anti-vibration function, which improves the riding experience by elevating comfort on uneven and bumpy surfaces.

“At Basso we take nothing for granted. We believe in engineering as the baseline, attention to detail and beauty. With this attitude, we took the path that led us to the development of the new Paradigm Integration System: stem, spacers, head-set”. Alcide Basso

Developed from the ground up taking off road comfort as the main focus, we reduced the section of the handlebar to integrate a 4.5 mm thickness bar tape and studied ergonomics in all hands positions, from the tops to the drops.
